Legs extend diagonally slightly ahead to counterbalance, no enormous lumbar bend. Head follows upper spine/torso, gaze up along chest direction. Side-three-quarter camera shows difference from vertical ordinary chinup. Stable real rack with mounted bar and grounded bases, all extremities.
